author: Bayerische Staatsbibliothek (ed.)
title: 100(0) Schlüsseldokumente zur russischen und sowjetischen Geschichte (1917–1991)
notes: A curated digital edition of key documents of Russian and Soviet history, each with a facsimile, a transcription and an archival reference — which is what makes it usable where a volunteer transcription is not. This pack takes from it the Russian text of the Military Revolutionary Committee's proclamation of 25 October 1917 and of the act of abdication (its record cites ГАРФ, ф. 601, оп. 1, д. 2470). The registry's Schlieffen memorandum entry is from the same edition's German series.
